LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 4.3.1 WORD CLASS: POSSESSIVE PRONOUNS

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 4
Topic 4.3: Grammar in Use 4.3.1 Word Class: Possessive Pronouns

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Grammar in Use 4.3.1 Word Class: Possessive Pronouns. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why should we use possessive forms correctly?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify possessive forms in print or digital texts
2. use possessive forms correctly in sentences

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: GRAMMAR IN USE 4.3.1 WORD CLASS: POSSESSIVE PRONOUNS
This lesson teaches Grammar in Use 4.3.1 Word Class: Possessive Pronouns for Grade 5 ENGLISH LANGUAGE.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify possessive forms in print or digital texts
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. use possessive forms correctly in sentences
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Grammar in Use 4.3.1 Word Class: Possessive Pronouns using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Grammar in Use 4.3.1 Word Class: Possessive Pronouns above.
2. Explain Grammar in Use 4.3.1 Word Class: Possessive Pronouns to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Grammar in Use 4.3.1 Word Class: Possessive Pronouns.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Grammar in Use 4.3.1 Word Class: Possessive Pronouns with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Grammar in Use 4.3.1 Word Class: Possessive Pronouns important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why should we use possessive forms correctly?
2. Which words show something belongs to a person?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify possessive forms in print or digital texts
2. use possessive forms correctly in sentences

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
